p7a.title: Online Review
p7a.text:
★★★★☆  Riverton Suites
Reviewed by Daniel Okafor · March 14

I stayed at the Riverton Suites for three nights while attending a trade fair downtown. The location could not have been better: the convention center is a five-minute walk away, and there are plenty of restaurants nearby. My room was spacious and spotless, and the bed was extremely comfortable.

The staff deserve special mention. When I realized I had left my laptop charger at home, the front desk lent me one within minutes, free of charge.

My only real complaint concerns the fitness center. It closes at 8 P.M., which is far too early for business travelers who spend the whole day in meetings. I also found the Wi-Fi in my room somewhat slow, although it worked well enough in the lobby.

Overall, I would happily stay here again on my next business trip, and I have already recommended it to two colleagues.

p7e.title: Article
p7e.text:
GREENFIELD (April 2) — Halvorsen Foods, the region's largest producer of frozen meals, announced yesterday that it will build a second factory on the outskirts of Greenfield. Construction is scheduled to begin in July, and the facility is expected to be fully operational within eighteen months.

The decision follows two years of record sales, driven largely by the company's line of ready-made vegetarian dishes. "Our current plant is running at full capacity," said CEO Margaret Halvorsen. "The new site will allow us to meet demand and to introduce products we have been developing for some time." [1]

The factory will create approximately 350 jobs. [2] Halvorsen Foods plans to recruit locally and will hold an information session for job seekers at the Greenfield Community Center on May 15. [3]

Not everyone welcomes the project. Some residents have raised concerns about increased truck traffic on Route 9. [4] In response, the company has agreed to fund improvements to the road before the factory opens.

p7g.title: Product Review
p7g.text:
Voxa Q7 Wireless Headphones
Posted by Hannah Weber

I bought the Q7 to use on my daily train commute, and for that purpose they have been excellent. The noise cancellation blocks out almost all background sound, and the battery easily lasts a full week of commuting on a single charge.

That said, the Q7 is not perfect. The headband becomes uncomfortable after about two hours, so I would not recommend these headphones for long flights. I was also disappointed that a carrying case is not included, considering the price.

When one of the ear cushions came loose after a month, I contacted Voxa's customer service. A replacement arrived within three days, and I was not charged anything.

Would I buy them again? For commuting, absolutely. For anything longer, I would look at other models.

t01.title: Conversation with three speakers
lines: Kevin, Raj, do you have a minute? I just got an e-mail from the conference center. They've double-booked the Lakeview Room for our client workshop on the twelfth.
Seriously? We confirmed that reservation back in March. Did they offer us anything else?
They can give us the Garden Hall instead, but it only seats forty, and we already have fifty-two people registered.

What if we split the workshop into a morning session and an afternoon session? Twenty-six people each would fit easily. And smaller groups might actually make the hands-on exercises run more smoothly.
Raj, that would mean asking the trainers to stay for the whole day, though.
I spoke with them last week, and they said their schedules are flexible. I'll call them this afternoon to confirm.
Great. Then I'll let the conference center know we'll take the Garden Hall.
t01.zh: 梅根：凱文、拉吉，有空嗎？會議中心剛寄信來，說湖景廳在 12 號重複訂給兩組人，跟我們的客戶工作坊撞了。／凱文：真的假的？我們三月就確認了。他們有提供別的選擇嗎？／梅根：可以改給我們花園廳，但只坐得下 40 人，我們已經有 52 人報名。／拉吉：那把工作坊拆成上午場和下午場呢？一場 26 人很容易坐得下，人少一點，實作練習說不定還更順。／凱文：拉吉，不過這樣講師就得待一整天。／拉吉：我上週跟他們談過，他們說時間很彈性。我今天下午打電話跟他們確認。／梅根：太好了。那我就跟會議中心說我們要花園廳。

t02.title: Conversation and price list
lines: Hi. I'd like to order two hundred copies of this product brochure. We're exhibiting at an industry fair in Chicago this week.
Sure. When do you need them by?
Well, today's Monday, and my flight leaves Wednesday afternoon. So I'd need them before then.
Our two-day service would have them ready by six P.M. on Wednesday.
Hmm, that's too late. I'll be at the airport by then. I'd better go with the faster option, even if it costs more.
No problem. And if you e-mail me the file now, I can send you a proof within the hour, so you can check the colors before we print everything.
t02.zh: 女：你好，我想印這份產品手冊 200 份。我們這週要在芝加哥的產業展覽會參展。／男：好的，什麼時候要？／女：今天星期一，我的班機是星期三下午，所以要在那之前拿到。／男：我們的兩天服務會在星期三下午六點前印好。／女：嗯，那太晚了，那時候我已經在機場了。還是選更快的吧，貴一點也沒關係。／男：沒問題。如果你現在把檔案 email 給我，我一小時內寄樣張給你，你可以在全部印之前先確認顏色。

t03.title: Telephone message
lines: Hi, Ms. Duarte, this is Leo from Harvest Valley Produce. I'm calling about tomorrow's delivery. Our refrigerated truck broke down this morning, and the repair shop says it won't be ready until Thursday.

Now, I know you're hosting that private banquet tomorrow night. I've arranged to borrow a van from a partner company, but it's quite a bit smaller, so we can bring only about half of your order in the morning. The rest would arrive around four in the afternoon.
Is that cutting it close for your kitchen staff? Let me know.
Oh, and to make up for the trouble, we won't be charging you a delivery fee this month. You can reach me at 555-0148. Thanks.
t03.zh: 杜阿爾特女士您好，我是豐收谷農產的里歐，打來是為了明天的送貨。我們的冷藏車今天早上故障了，修車廠說要到星期四才修得好。我知道您明天晚上要辦一場私人宴會。我已經跟合作廠商借了一台廂型車，但車子小很多，所以早上只能先送大約一半，其餘的下午四點左右送到。這樣對您的廚房人員來說會不會太趕？再跟我說。喔，還有，為了彌補這次的麻煩，這個月我們不收運費。請打 555-0148 找我，謝謝。

t04.title: Conversation with three speakers
lines: Thanks for making time, Dr. Brooks, Priya. I'm here to show you the new booking system before it goes live on Monday. And don't worry, nothing will get lost in the switch this time.
Fair enough. But this time all your existing appointments transfer automatically overnight, and I'll personally check every record on Sunday evening.
What about the text reminders we send patients? Our missed appointments dropped by half after we started using those.
They're built in. And now you can choose when they go out, either two days before the appointment or that morning.
Priya, you're the one at the front desk every day. Would you be able to try it out this weekend?
I'm away on Saturday, but I could come in on Sunday for an hour or two.
Perfect. I'll set up a practice account for you this afternoon.
t04.zh: 安娜：布魯克斯醫師、普莉雅，謝謝撥空。我來示範星期一要上線的新預約系統。放心，這次轉換不會有資料遺失。／布魯克斯醫師：這句話我聽過了。／安娜：可以理解。不過這次所有現有的預約都會在夜裡自動轉過去，星期天晚上我也會親自逐筆檢查。／普莉雅：那我們傳給病人的簡訊提醒呢？開始用之後，爽約的人少了一半。／安娜：系統內建，而且現在可以選發送時間：看診前兩天或當天早上。／布魯克斯醫師：普莉雅，每天在櫃台的是你。這個週末你能試用看看嗎？／普莉雅：我星期六不在，但星期天可以來一兩個小時。／安娜：太好了，我今天下午幫你開一個練習帳號。

t05.title: Conversation with three speakers and room list
lines: Lena, Tom, we need a room for Thursday's budget review. The Seoul team will be joining us by video.
How many of us will be there in person?
Nine, including the two new analysts.
Then Maple's out, and Cedar doesn't have the video equipment. Birch should work.
Hmm, Birch is right next to the break room, and it gets really noisy around lunchtime. Last time, the Seoul team could barely hear us.
Good point. Let's just book the largest one. It's more space than we need, but at least it's quiet.
I'll reserve it now. And I'll send the Seoul team the meeting link this afternoon.
t05.zh: 丹尼爾：蕾娜、湯姆，星期四的預算檢討需要一間會議室，首爾團隊會用視訊加入。／蕾娜：我們這邊實際到場幾個人？／丹尼爾：九個，包括兩位新來的分析師。／湯姆：那楓木廳不行，雪松廳又沒有視訊設備。樺木廳應該可以。／蕾娜：嗯，樺木廳就在茶水間旁邊，午餐時間很吵。上次首爾團隊幾乎聽不到我們講話。／丹尼爾：說得對。直接訂最大間吧，空間比需要的大，但至少安靜。／湯姆：我現在就訂。下午我會把會議連結寄給首爾團隊。

t06.title: Conversation with three speakers
lines: Ken, Julia, the Harlow Group just called. They want three hundred pastries for a company event. On Friday.
This Friday? We normally ask for at least a week's notice for an order that size.
I know. But they've ordered from us every month for two years, so I'd really like to make this work.
If we push the seasonal menu tasting back to next week, the morning team would have time to handle it.
And I can come in early on Thursday and Friday to help with the baking.
Thank you both. Oh, and they asked if we could deliver the order this time. They've always picked it up themselves.
That's a first. Our van's booked for the farmers market on Friday morning, though.
My cousin runs a courier service. I'll check whether he's free.
t06.zh: 瑪莉索：肯、茱莉亞，哈洛集團剛打電話來，公司活動要訂 300 個糕點，星期五要。／肯：這個星期五？這種量我們通常要求至少一週前預訂。／瑪莉索：我知道，但他們兩年來每個月都跟我們訂，我很想接下來。／茱莉亞：如果把季節菜單試吃延到下週，早班就有時間做。／肯：我星期四、星期五也可以早點來幫忙烤。／瑪莉索：謝謝你們。喔，他們還問這次能不能幫忙送貨，以前都是他們自己來拿。／肯：這倒是頭一遭。不過我們的貨車星期五早上要去農夫市集。／茱莉亞：我表哥開快遞公司，我問問他有沒有空。

t07.title: Conversation and chart
lines: Have you had a chance to look at the results of the customer survey?
Yes, I went through them this morning. Most people who canceled their meal-kit subscriptions mentioned price.
That's not surprising. But pricing decisions come from head office, so there's not much our team can do about that.
Right. So I think we should focus on the next biggest issue instead. If we fix that, we could win back quite a few customers.
Agreed. Could you put together a proposal by next Wednesday? I'd like to present it at the regional managers' meeting.
Sure. I'll need the cancellation data from the last two quarters, though.
I'll ask Hiro in analytics to send it to you today.
t07.zh: 男：你看過顧客問卷的結果了嗎？／女：看了，今天早上看完。取消訂閱餐盒的人，大多數提到價格。／男：不意外。但價格是總公司決定的，我們團隊能做的不多。／女：對，所以我覺得我們應該改處理第二大的問題。解決了那個，可以挽回不少顧客。／男：同意。你能在下星期三前寫一份提案嗎？我想在區域經理會議上報告。／女：可以，不過我需要最近兩季的取消資料。／男：我今天請分析部的廣志寄給你。

t08.title: Conversation with three speakers
lines: So, Dev, where are we with the renovation of our second floor?
Mostly on schedule. The new walls are up, and the electrical work was finished yesterday. The one issue is the flooring. Sam from our supplier is here to explain.
Unfortunately, the manufacturer has stopped producing the oak pattern you chose. I've brought samples of two similar options.
Hmm, these are both a bit lighter than the original. Would either of them be available sooner?
This one's in stock at our warehouse. The other would take about three weeks to arrive.
Then let's go with the one in stock. Our staff are supposed to move back in at the start of next month.
In that case, we can have the floors done by the twenty-fifth. I'll update the schedule and e-mail it to you tonight.
t08.zh: 歐提茲女士：戴夫，我們二樓的裝修進度如何？／戴夫：大致照進度。新的隔間牆都立好了，電路工程昨天完成。唯一的問題是地板，供應商的山姆來說明。／山姆：很遺憾，製造商已經停產您選的那款橡木紋。我帶了兩款類似的樣品。／歐提茲女士：嗯，這兩款都比原本的淺一點。有哪一款可以比較快拿到嗎？／山姆：這款我們倉庫有現貨，另一款大約要三週才到。／歐提茲女士：那就用有現貨的。我們員工預定下個月初搬回來。／戴夫：那我們 25 號前可以把地板完成。我今晚更新時程表再 email 給您。

t09.title: Talk and schedule
lines: Good afternoon, everyone, and welcome back from lunch. Before the sessions begin, I have a quick update on the schedule for this room.
Unfortunately, Omar Haddad's flight was delayed, and he won't get here until about two thirty. So he and Nadia Petrov have kindly agreed to switch time slots. Everything else stays the same.
Now, I know many of you signed up for the panel discussion at four. Fifty people, forty chairs.
Finally, please don't forget to fill out the feedback form in the conference app. Everyone who completes it will be entered in a drawing for a free pass to next year's event.
t09.zh: 大家午安，歡迎用完午餐回來。在場次開始前，先快速更新這間會議室的時程。很可惜，歐馬．哈達德的班機延誤，大約兩點半才會到，所以他和娜迪亞．佩特洛娃好心答應互換時段，其他都不變。另外，我知道很多人報名了四點的座談。50 個人，40 張椅子。最後，別忘了在大會 App 填寫回饋表，填完的人都可以參加抽獎，獎品是明年大會的免費入場證。

questions.q: The new software allows employees to complete expense reports more ______ than before.
questions.exp: more ______ than 修飾的是動作 complete，要用副詞 efficiently。
questions.zh: 新軟體讓員工能比以前更有效率地完成費用報告。

questions.q: Ms. Tanaka's ______ to the project has been praised by the entire board.
questions.exp: 所有格 Ms. Tanaka's 後面接名詞，而且它是句子的主詞 → contribution。
questions.zh: 田中小姐對這個專案的貢獻受到整個董事會的稱讚。

questions.q: All visitors must remain ______ while the safety demonstration is in progress.
questions.exp: remain 是連綴動詞，後面接形容詞。seated（坐著的）是常考的分詞形容詞。
questions.zh: 安全示範進行期間，所有訪客都必須保持坐著。

questions.q: The quarterly report was ______ longer than the one submitted last year.
questions.exp: 修飾比較級 longer 要用副詞：considerably / much / far longer。
questions.zh: 這份季報比去年提交的那份長了許多。

questions.q: By the time the merger is finalized next spring, the company ______ three new regional offices.
questions.exp: By the time + 未來時間（next spring）→ 主要子句用未來完成式 will have p.p.。
questions.zh: 等到合併案明年春天定案時，公司將已開設三間新的區域辦事處。

questions.q: The conference room ______ while the new projector is being installed.
questions.exp: 主詞是「會議室」（物），空格後沒有受詞 → 被動 cannot be used。
questions.zh: 新投影機安裝期間，會議室無法使用。

questions.q: Since joining the firm in 2019, Mr. Ruiz ______ more than forty client accounts.
questions.exp: Since + 過去時間點，表示「從那時到現在」→ 現在完成式 has managed。
questions.zh: 自從 2019 年加入公司以來，魯伊斯先生已經負責管理超過四十個客戶帳戶。

questions.q: The manager insisted that every report ______ reviewed by two people before release.
questions.exp: insist / recommend / require that + 主詞 + 原形動詞（should 被省略）→ be reviewed。
questions.zh: 經理堅持每份報告在發布前都要經過兩個人審閱。

questions.q: ______ the heavy rain, the outdoor product launch went ahead as scheduled.
questions.exp: 空格後是名詞片語 the heavy rain（不是子句）→ 用介系詞 Despite；Although 後面要接子句。
questions.zh: 儘管下大雨，戶外產品發表會仍照原定計畫舉行。

questions.q: Please submit the form by Friday ______ your request can be processed before the holiday.
questions.exp: 空格後是完整子句（your request can be processed）→ 用連接詞 so that（以便）。in order to 後面接原形動詞。
questions.zh: 請在週五前繳交表格，以便您的申請能在假期前處理完畢。

questions.q: Participants may choose ______ the morning session or the afternoon workshop.
questions.exp: either A or B（A 或 B 擇一）。both 配 and，neither 配 nor。
questions.zh: 參加者可以選擇上午場或下午的工作坊（二選一）。

questions.q: The shipment was delayed ______ a shortage of packaging materials.
questions.exp: 空格後是名詞片語 a shortage of… → 表原因的介系詞 owing to（= because of / due to）。because、since 表原因時要接子句。
questions.zh: 由於包裝材料短缺，這批貨延遲出貨了。

questions.q: ______ you have any questions about the new policy, please contact the HR department.
questions.exp: If you should have… 省略 If 後倒裝成 Should you have…，是 Part 5 常考的商用信件句型。
questions.zh: 如果您對新政策有任何問題，請聯絡人資部門。

questions.q: The architect ______ design won the award will speak at tomorrow's ceremony.
questions.exp: 空格後直接接名詞 design，表示「建築師的設計」→ 所有格關係代名詞 whose。
questions.zh: 設計作品得獎的那位建築師將在明天的典禮上致詞。

questions.q: Not only ______ the budget, but the team also finished the project two weeks early.
questions.exp: Not only 放句首要倒裝：Not only + 助動詞 + 主詞 + 原形動詞 → did the team stay。
questions.zh: 團隊不只沒有超出預算，還提早兩週完成了專案。

questions.q: Because of the ______ in the figures, the auditors asked for the original receipts.
questions.exp: 數字「不一致」所以要看原始收據 → discrepancy（差異、不符）。
questions.zh: 由於數字有出入，稽核人員要求查看原始收據。

questions.q: The hotel agreed to ______ the cancellation fee because the flight had been canceled.
questions.exp: waive a fee（免收費用）是固定搭配。
questions.zh: 因為班機被取消，飯店同意免收取消費。

questions.q: Applicants should ______ all relevant documents to the personnel office by May 3.
questions.exp: forward A to B（把 A 寄送給 B）。inform / notify / remind 的受詞要是「人」。
questions.zh: 應徵者應在 5 月 3 日前將所有相關文件寄送給人事室。

questions.q: The new branch is expected to be highly ______, generating profits within its first year.
questions.exp: 後半句說「第一年就獲利」→ lucrative（賺錢的）。
questions.zh: 新分店預期會非常賺錢，第一年就能獲利。

questions.q: Ms. Lee was ______ for her outstanding work on the client survey.
questions.exp: be recognized for…（因……受到表揚）是表揚員工的常見說法。
questions.zh: 李小姐因為在客戶調查上的傑出表現而受到表揚。

questions.exp: 介系詞 for 後面接名詞：closed for refurbishment（整修暫停開放）。
questions.zh: 從下週一開始，三樓的茶水間將關閉整修。

questions.q: [2] 哪一句最適合放在這裡？
opts: Please remember to remove any personal items from the refrigerator by Friday.
The second floor has recently been sold to another company.
Our quarterly sales figures exceeded expectations.
Applications for the position close on Friday.
questions.exp: 前一句說廚房要關閉，這句提醒「週五前把冰箱私人物品拿走」最連貫。其他三句和廚房整修無關。
questions.zh: 請記得在週五前把冰箱裡的私人物品拿走。

questions.exp: 整修「之後」會有新咖啡機和座位 → Following（= After）。
questions.zh: 整修完成之後，會有新的咖啡機和更多座位。

questions.exp: 所有格 your 後面接名詞；appreciate your patience（感謝您的耐心）是公告結尾的固定說法。patients 是「病人」。
questions.zh: 造成不便敬請見諒，並感謝您的耐心。

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the email?
opts: To confirm details of a speaking engagement
To invite Ms. Kim to apply for a job
To request payment for a conference pass
To announce a change of venue
questions.exp: 第一段感謝她答應主持工作坊，並說明時段和講者福利 → 確認演講安排。
questions.zh: 題目：這封 email 的主要目的是什麼？ ／ 答案：確認一場演講的細節。

questions.q: What is Ms. Kim asked to do by October 10?
questions.exp: send your presentation slides ... no later than October 10 → 題目把 slides 改寫成 presentation materials（同義改寫）。
questions.zh: 題目：金小姐被要求在 10 月 10 日前做什麼？ ／ 答案：繳交她的簡報資料。

questions.q: What is indicated about the program?
opts: It will be sent for printing after October 3.
It covers three days of sessions.
It was designed by Ms. Kim.
questions.exp: after that date (October 3), the program will be sent to the printer → 10 月 3 日之後送印。
questions.zh: 題目：關於議程，文中提到什麼？ ／ 答案：它會在 10 月 3 日之後送印。

questions.q: Where will Ms. Kim most likely lead her workshop?
questions.exp: 要兩篇對照：email 說她講 social media analytics，議程表上這一場在 Room B。
questions.zh: 題目：金小姐最可能在哪裡主持她的工作坊？ ／ 答案：在 B 會議室。

audio: Who's in charge of ordering office supplies this month?
A. Yes, I ordered them yesterday.
B. I think it's Megan's turn.
questions.q: 選出最適當的回應
questions.exp: Who 問「誰」→ B 回答人名。A 用 Yes 回答 Who 問句一定錯，而且重複 order 是陷阱；C 回答的是 Where。
questions.zh: 問：這個月誰負責訂辦公用品？ ／ (A) 對，我昨天訂了。(B) 我想輪到梅根了。(C) 在第三層架子上。

audio: Shouldn't we leave for the airport soon?
A. The flight's been delayed an hour.
B. Yes, I left it there.
questions.q: 選出最適當的回應
questions.exp: 間接回答：不說 Yes / No，而是用「班機延誤一小時」暗示不用急著走。B 用 left 當陷阱，C 重複 airport。
questions.zh: 問：我們不是該準備去機場了嗎？ ／ (A) 班機延誤一小時了。(B) 對，我把它留在那裡了。(C) 那是一座很大的機場。

p: 你在 Santa 的數據顯示，作答速度沒有問題：Part 5 平均每題 12 秒、Part 6 29 秒、Part 7 36 秒，都比建議時間快。真正失分的是「正確率」，尤其是詞彙（76%）和 Part 5（77%），是你五項能力和七個大題裡最低的。
所以 Part 5 的策略是：用省下來的時間多確認一次，不要因為快而粗心。下面是閱讀 75 分鐘的建議分配，你目前的速度已經在這個範圍內：
steps: 先看選項，判斷題型（3 秒內）。
文法題看空格前後就能作答；作答後花 2 到 3 秒把句子順一遍，確認沒有被陷阱騙。
詞彙題要讀整句。你的弱點在詞彙，遇到不確定的字，先排除詞性或搭配不合的選項，再比較語意。
notes.tip: 你的 Santa 預測分數是 870，正式考卻是 755。速度和實力都夠，落差多半來自考場狀況（緊張、後段疲勞、現場音響）。之後的「閱讀全真計時」會專門練這一塊。

notes.h: 詞性題：看位置，不用看意思
p: 選項是同一個字根的不同字尾時，就是詞性題。這類題目只要判斷空格在句子裡的位置該放什麼詞性，幾乎不用懂句意。

head: 空格的位置
要填
例子
rows: a / the / 所有格 + ___ + 名詞
a / the / 所有格 / 介系詞 + ___（後面沒有名詞）
完整句子的最後，修飾動詞

p2: 看不出詞性時，用字尾判斷：
ex: The committee will review your proposal and notify you of its ______ within ten days.  (decide / decision / decisive / decisively)
所有格 its 後面接名詞 → decision。
Sales have increased ______ since the new campaign began.  (steady / steadily / steadiness / steadied)
修飾動詞 increased → 副詞 steadily。
notes.tip: 陷阱：friendly、timely、costly、orderly、likely 雖然是 -ly 結尾，卻是形容詞。另外 hard（努力地）和 hardly（幾乎不）、late（晚）和 lately（最近）意思完全不同。

p: 選項是同一個動詞的不同時態時，先在句子裡找「時間線索」。多益很少考需要細細體會的時態，幾乎都有明確的關鍵字。

head: 看到這個線索
用這個時態
例句
rows: since + 過去時間點、for + 一段時間、so far、recently
現在完成式 has / have p.p.
by the time / by + 未來時間、by next month
未來完成式 will have p.p.
by the time + 過去事件、before + 過去事件
had left before the meeting began
未來式 will / be going to

p2: 高分常考的例外：時間或條件子句（when、once、until、before、after、as soon as、if）裡面，要用現在式代替未來式。
ex: We will send the invoice as soon as the order ______.  (ships / will ship)
as soon as 是時間子句，用現在式 ships。主要子句才用 will。
By the time the new manager arrives, the team ______ the report.  (completes / will have completed)
by the time + 未來事件 → will have completed。

p: 選項裡同時有主動和被動（例如 review / is reviewed）時，看兩件事：空格後面有沒有受詞，以及主詞是人還是物。
steps: 空格後面有受詞（名詞）→ 主動。
空格後面沒有受詞、直接接介系詞或句子結束 → 被動 be + p.p.。
主詞是物（report、package、room、product）時，被動的機率很高，但仍以「有沒有受詞」為準。

head: 分類
單字
rows: 沒有被動的不及物動詞（常拿來當陷阱）
be required to、be expected to、be scheduled to、be entitled to、be committed to、be dedicated to、be located in、be based in
被動後面還接受詞的動詞（授與動詞）
be given、be offered、be awarded、be sent、be granted（例：was awarded a prize）

ex: The new safety guidelines ______ to all employees last week.  (distributed / were distributed)
後面沒有受詞，指南是「被」發送 → were distributed。
The price of raw materials ______ sharply this quarter.  (has risen / has been risen)
rise 是不及物動詞，沒有被動 → has risen。

notes.h: 連接詞 vs 介系詞
p: 選項同時出現意思相近的連接詞和介系詞時（例如 although / despite），只要看空格後面接的是什麼：完整子句（有主詞和動詞）就用連接詞；名詞、名詞片語或 V-ing 就用介系詞。

head: 意思
連接詞（+ 子句）
介系詞（+ 名詞）
rows: because of、due to、owing to、on account of
in order to + 原形動詞、for
in case of、in the event of

p2: 成對出現的對等連接詞，看到其中一半就能選出另一半：

head: 句型
意思
rows: A 或 B 其中一個
不論是 A 還是 B
A 以及 B（動詞跟 A 一致）

ex: ______ the delay in shipping, the store opened on schedule.  (Although / Despite)
後面是名詞片語 the delay… → Despite。
Please arrive early ______ we can begin promptly at nine.  (so that / in order to)
後面是子句 we can begin… → so that。
notes.tip: 副詞 however、therefore、moreover 不能連接兩個子句。看到「子句, ___ 子句」時，要選連接詞，不能選這些副詞。

p: 選項是 who / which / whose / that 這類關係詞時，先看前面的先行詞是人還是物，再看空格後面缺什麼。

head: 空格後面
先行詞是人
先行詞是物
rows: 缺受詞（接主詞 + 動詞）
接完整句子，表地點／時間

steps: 逗號後面不能用 that：The CEO, who founded the company, …
介系詞後面不能用 that：the office in which she works
what 自己就包含先行詞（= the thing that），前面不能再有名詞。
ex: Applicants ______ résumés are incomplete will not be considered.  (who / whose)
空格後直接接名詞 résumés → whose。
The conference, ______ is held every spring, attracts over 2,000 visitors.  (which / that)
逗號後面不能用 that → which。

p: 這是 800 分以上常卡住的題型。題目通常會把 if 省略，改成倒裝句，考你能不能認出來。

head: 假設類型
原本的句型
省略 if 的倒裝
rows: 未來可能（商用信件最常見）
If we had known, we would have …
Had we known, we would have …

p2: 另一種倒裝是否定或限定的副詞放在句首：Never、Rarely、Seldom、Not only、Only after、Only when、Hardly。這時主要子句要改成「助動詞 + 主詞 + 動詞」。
還有一類是「要求、建議」的句型：insist、recommend、request、require、suggest、propose，以及 It is essential / important / necessary that…，後面的子句用原形動詞（should 被省略），主詞是單數也不加 s。
ex: ______ the shipment arrive damaged, please contact us within 48 hours.  (If / Should)
後面是原形 arrive，是省略 if 的倒裝 → Should。
Rarely ______ such strong sales in the first quarter.  (the company has seen / has the company seen)
Rarely 放句首要倒裝 → has the company seen。
The supervisor requested that the report ______ by noon.  (is submitted / be submitted)
request that + 原形 → be submitted。

notes.h: 虛構主詞 it（你的 Santa 弱點）
p: Santa 分析你這個概念的正確率是 47.3%，750 分使用者平均是 65.7%，是目前最需要補的文法點。
英文不喜歡主詞太長，所以會先放一個 it 佔住主詞或受詞的位置，把真正的內容（to V、that 子句）移到句子後面。

head: 句型
真正的主詞／受詞
例句
rows: It is + 形容詞 + to V
It is important to back up your files.
It is + 形容詞 + that 子句
It is essential that everyone attend.
It is expected / said / reported that…
It is expected that sales will rise.
It takes + 時間 + to V
It takes two days to process an order.
find / make / consider + it + 形容詞 + to V
We found it difficult to meet the deadline.

steps: 空格在句首、後面接 is / was + 形容詞或 p.p.，再往後有 to V 或 that 子句 → 選 It。
There is / are 後面接的是名詞（There are three options），不能接 that 子句。
find / make / consider 後面直接接形容詞再接 to V 時，中間要補 it。
ex: ______ is necessary to renew your parking permit every year.  (It / There / This)
後面有真正的主詞 to renew… → It。
The new software makes ______ easier to track expenses.  (it / that / them)
make it + 形容詞 + to V → it。
notes.tip: 看到選項裡有 It / There / This / What，先往後找有沒有 to V 或 that 子句；有的話幾乎都是 It。

notes.h: 主詞動詞一致與比較級
p: 選項是 is / are、has / have 這種單複數變化時，要找出真正的主詞，不要被中間插入的修飾語騙了。

head: 主詞
動詞
例句
rows: the number of + 複數名詞
The number of orders has increased.
a number of + 複數名詞
A number of orders have been canceled.
Every employee is required to attend.
one of the + 複數名詞
One of the printers is broken.
either / neither of + 複數名詞
Neither of the candidates has experience.
A as well as B / A along with B
The manager, as well as her staff, is attending.

steps: 加強比較級用 much、far、even、still、considerably、significantly，不能用 very。
the + 比較級…, the + 比較級…：The earlier you register, the lower the fee.
as + 原級 + as：中間用原級，不用比較級（as quickly as possible）。
ex: The number of visitors to the museum ______ doubled since the renovation.  (has / have)
主詞是 The number → 單數 has。
This year's profits are ______ higher than expected.  (very / significantly)
修飾比較級 higher → significantly。
notes.tip: 做完這份講義，可以先看重點卡快速複習一次，再去做練習。練習答錯的題目會自動放進錯題本。

cards.title: 先看選項，3 秒判斷題型
points: 選項是同一個字的不同字尾 → 詞性題：只看空格前後，不用讀完整句。
選項是同一個動詞的不同形式 → 時態／語態題：找時間線索、看主詞是人還是物。
選項是 although / despite 這類 → 句構題：看後面接子句還是名詞。
選項是意思不同的字 → 詞彙題：要讀懂句意，最花時間，放最後處理。
ex: The proposal was reviewed ______ by the committee.  (careful / carefully / care / caring)
選項都是 care 的變化 → 詞性題。空格修飾動詞 reviewed → carefully。

cards.title: 詞性題：只看空格前後
points: a / the / 所有格 + ____ + 名詞 → 形容詞
a / the / 所有格 / 介系詞 + ____ → 名詞
be 動詞 + ____ + p.p. / 動詞 → 副詞
連綴動詞 remain / become / seem + ____ → 形容詞
修飾比較級（much / far / considerably）→ 副詞
ex: The new system is ______ easier to use.
修飾比較級 easier → considerably / much / far。

cards.title: 時態：找時間線索
points: since + 過去時間點、for + 一段時間 → 現在完成式 has / have p.p.
by the time / by + 未來時間 → 未來完成式 will have p.p.
by the time + 過去事件 → 過去完成式 had p.p.
next / upcoming / soon → 未來；last / ago / yesterday → 過去
時間或條件子句（when / once / until / before）用現在式代替未來式
ex: We will start the meeting once everyone ______.  (arrives / will arrive)
once 引導時間子句，用現在式 arrives。

cards.title: 語態：主動還是被動？
points: 空格後有受詞 → 主動；沒有受詞 → 多半是被動 be + p.p.
主詞是物（report、package、room）時特別注意被動
不及物動詞沒有被動：last、occur、happen、arrive、rise
be required to / be expected to / be scheduled to 是常考被動片語
ex: The workshop will ______ for two hours.  (last / be lasted)
last 是不及物動詞，沒有被動 → will last。

cards.title: 連接詞 vs 介系詞
points: 後面接子句（主詞 + 動詞）→ 連接詞；接名詞或 V-ing → 介系詞
雖然：although / even though（連）↔ despite / in spite of（介）
因為：because / since（連）↔ because of / due to / owing to（介）
在……期間：while（連）↔ during（介）
以便：so that + 子句 ↔ in order to + 原形動詞
ex: ______ the delay, the shipment arrived in good condition.
後面是名詞 the delay → Despite。

cards.title: 高分陷阱題型
points: Should you have… = If you should have…（省略 if 倒裝）
Had I known… = If I had known…（與過去事實相反）
insist / recommend / require / essential that + 主詞 + 原形動詞
Not only / Only after / Never 放句首 → 助動詞倒裝
the number of + 複數名詞 + 單數動詞；a number of + 複數動詞
whose + 名詞（所有格關係詞）；比較級前用 much / far / even 加強
ex: ______ you need further assistance, please call us.
省略 If 的倒裝 → Should you need…

practice.q: The marketing team presented a ______ analysis of last quarter's sales.
practice.exp: 冠詞 a + ____ + 名詞 analysis → 形容詞 detailed（詳細的）。
practice.zh: 行銷團隊針對上一季的銷售做了一份詳細的分析。

practice.q: Ms. Patel has worked at the firm ______ she graduated from university.
practice.exp: 現在完成式 + since + 過去時間點（子句）。for 接一段時間，during 接名詞。
practice.zh: 帕特爾小姐從大學畢業後就一直在這間公司工作。

practice.q: The packages ______ to the wrong address because of a system error.
practice.exp: 包裹是「被」寄送，空格後沒有受詞 → 被動 were delivered。
practice.zh: 因為系統錯誤，包裹被送到錯誤的地址。

practice.q: ______ the high cost of the materials, the project stayed within budget.
practice.exp: 後面是名詞片語 the high cost… → 介系詞 Despite。
practice.zh: 儘管材料成本很高，這個專案仍然沒有超出預算。

practice.q: Employees are encouraged to communicate ______ with their supervisors.
practice.exp: 修飾動詞 communicate → 副詞 regularly。
practice.zh: 公司鼓勵員工定期和主管溝通。

practice.q: The CEO, ______ has led the company for ten years, will retire in June.
practice.exp: 先行詞是人（CEO），空格後缺主詞（___ has led）→ who。
practice.zh: 已經帶領公司十年的執行長將在六月退休。

practice.q: By the end of next month, we ______ all of the old equipment.
practice.exp: By + 未來時間 → 未來完成式 will have replaced。
practice.zh: 到下個月底前，我們將已經汰換所有舊設備。

practice.q: The committee recommended that the deadline ______ by one week.
practice.exp: recommend that + 原形動詞；截止日是「被」延長 → be extended。
practice.zh: 委員會建議把截止日延後一週。

practice.q: The new policy will take effect ______ the board approves it.
practice.exp: 後面是子句 the board approves it → 連接詞 once（一旦）。其他三個是介系詞。
practice.zh: 新政策一經董事會核准就會生效。

practice.q: The number of applicants for the position ______ increased sharply this year.
practice.exp: 主詞是 The number（數量），單數 → has。a number of 才接複數動詞。
practice.zh: 今年應徵這個職位的人數大幅增加。

practice.q: The company found ______ difficult to complete all the orders by the end of the month.
practice.exp: find it + 形容詞 + to V：it 是虛受詞，真正的受詞是後面的 to complete all the orders。
practice.zh: 公司發現要在月底前完成所有訂單很困難。

practice.q: ______ is expected that all department heads will attend the annual meeting.
practice.exp: It is expected that…：虛主詞 it 代替後面真正的主詞 that 子句。There 後面要接名詞。
practice.zh: 預計所有部門主管都會出席年度會議。

test.q: Ms. Chen gave a very ______ presentation on the company's expansion plans.
test.exp: a very + ____ + 名詞 → 形容詞 informative（資訊豐富的）。
test.zh: 陳小姐針對公司的擴張計畫做了一場很有內容的簡報。

test.q: The repairs were completed more ______ than the contractor had estimated.
test.exp: 修飾動詞 were completed → 副詞 quickly；more quickly than 是副詞比較級。
test.zh: 維修完成的速度比承包商預估的還快。

test.q: The ______ of the new branch has been postponed until May.
test.exp: The + ____ + of → 名詞 opening（開幕）。
test.zh: 新分店的開幕已經延到五月。

test.q: Mr. Owen ______ the sales department since the previous manager left.
test.exp: since + 子句（從那時到現在）→ 現在完成式 has led。
test.zh: 自從前任經理離職後，歐文先生就一直帶領業務部。

test.q: All passengers ______ to show their boarding passes at the gate.
test.exp: be required to do（被要求做）→ are required。
test.zh: 所有乘客都必須在登機門出示登機證。

test.q: The seminar ______ for three hours, so lunch will be provided.
test.exp: last 是不及物動詞，沒有被動 → will last。
test.zh: 研討會將持續三小時，所以會提供午餐。

test.q: ______ the printer is repaired, please use the one on the fifth floor.
test.exp: 後面是子句 → 連接詞 Until（在修好之前）。By、During、Despite 都是介系詞。
test.zh: 在印表機修好之前，請使用五樓的那台。

test.q: The event was a success ______ the poor weather.
test.exp: 後面是名詞片語 the poor weather → 介系詞 in spite of。
test.zh: 儘管天氣不好，活動還是很成功。

test.q: ______ Ms. Garcia nor her assistant was available to answer the call.
test.exp: 看到 nor → neither A nor B（兩者都不）。
test.zh: 賈西亞小姐和她的助理都沒空接電話。

test.q: The supplier ______ products failed the inspection has been contacted.
test.exp: 空格後直接接名詞 products（供應商的產品）→ whose。
test.zh: 產品沒通過檢驗的那家供應商已經被聯絡了。

test.q: ______ the proposal been submitted earlier, it would have been considered.
test.exp: If the proposal had been submitted… 省略 If 倒裝 → Had the proposal been submitted。
test.zh: 如果提案早一點提交，它就會被列入考慮了。

test.q: Only after the contract was signed ______ the details to the press.
test.exp: Only after… 放句首，主要子句要倒裝 → did the company release。
test.zh: 直到合約簽好之後，公司才向媒體公布細節。

test.q: The manager requires that each team member ______ a weekly progress report.
test.exp: require that + 主詞 + 原形動詞 → submit（即使主詞是單數也不加 s）。
test.zh: 經理要求每位組員都要繳交每週進度報告。

test.q: It is essential that the safety equipment ______ every morning.
test.exp: It is essential that + 原形動詞；設備是「被」檢查 → be checked。
test.zh: 安全設備必須每天早上檢查。

test.q: The new design is ______ more popular with customers than the old one.
test.exp: 比較級前加強語氣用 much / far / even，不能用 very。
test.zh: 新設計比舊設計受顧客歡迎得多。

p: 你的 Santa 數據裡，詞彙 76% 是五項能力中最低的。詞彙題和文法題不同：選項是四個意思不同的字，一定要讀懂整句。但「讀懂整句」不等於「每個字都要認識」，多數題目可以先用文法和搭配刪掉兩個選項，剩下的再比語意。

head: 詞彙題類型
判斷方法
例子
rows: 看空格後面接什麼（受詞、to V、that、介系詞）
看動詞和名詞、形容詞和名詞能不能放一起
意思接近，但使用情境不同
找 despite、because、but 這類線索決定正面或負面

p2: 你的速度很夠（Part 5 每題 12 秒），所以詞彙題可以放心多花幾秒，照下面的順序做：
steps: 讀整句，圈出線索：空格前後的介系詞（to / for / with / from）、受詞是什麼、句子有沒有 although / despite / because 這類邏輯詞。
先用「文法限制」刪：這個動詞後面能不能接 to V、that 子句、from V-ing？這個形容詞搭的是哪個介系詞？
再用「固定搭配」刪：這個動詞能不能接這個名詞（meet a deadline 可以，reach a deadline 不行）。
最後比語意：剩下的選項代回句子，用中文順一遍，選最自然、最符合句意的。
兩個都說得通時，找句子裡更具體的線索（時間、原因、對比），不要選「看起來比較高級」的字。
notes.tip: 詞彙題答錯最常見的原因不是不認識答案，而是「選了一個中文意思對、英文用法不對的字」。所以第 2、3 步比第 4 步更重要。

p: 很多選項中文意思都對，但後面接的東西不對。多益很愛把意思相近、句型不同的動詞放在一起考。看到動詞選項，先看空格後面接的是「人」、「that 子句」、「to V」還是「介系詞」。

head: 句型
可以用
不能這樣用（常見陷阱）
rows: 動詞 + 人 + that 子句
announce、explain、say（要寫 announce that… / explain to + 人）
動詞 + that + 主詞 + 原形動詞
動詞直接接受詞（不加介系詞）
discuss about、attend to the meeting（意思會變）
respond to、reply to、comply with、conform to、participate in、coincide with、culminate in
deem / consider + 受詞 + 形容詞
deem it necessary、consider the plan risky
regard / view / refer to 要加 as：regard it as risky

ex: The supervisor ______ the staff that the system would be offline on Sunday.  (informed / announced / explained / said)
空格後面直接接人 the staff + that 子句，只有 inform 可以。announce / explain / say 都不能直接接人。
The inspectors ______ the building unsafe for occupation.  (deemed / regarded / referred / viewed)
受詞後面直接接形容詞 unsafe → deemed。regarded / viewed 要加 as，referred 要用 referred to … as。
notes.tip: suggest 和 recommend 最常考：可以說 recommend that the team postpone…、recommend postponing…，但不能說 recommend the team to postpone。

p: 英文的動詞和名詞有固定組合，中文翻起來都一樣，英文卻只能用某一個。下面是多益最常出現的組合，建議整組背，不要只背單字。

head: 動詞
常接的名詞
中文
rows: 趕上期限、滿足需求、符合要求
進行調查、研究、檢查、面試
籌募資金、提高價格、提高意識、提出疑慮
採取措施、生效、利用、舉行、預防
達成協議、決定、共識、目標
徵求意見、募捐、徵求提案
超出預期、超過上限、超出預算

ex: We hired extra staff so that we could ______ the holiday demand.  (meet / reach / achieve / gain)
demand 的動詞是 meet（或 satisfy）。reach 接 agreement / goal，achieve 接 goal / result。
The airline will ______ the change fee for passengers affected by the strike.  (waive / solicit / procure / impede)
waive the fee 免除費用，是 Santa 收藏字裡最常考的搭配。

notes.h: be + 形容詞 + 介系詞
p: 形容詞題的另一個刪法：看空格後面的介系詞。下面這些形容詞和介系詞是綁在一起的，介系詞不對就可以直接刪掉。

head: 介系詞
形容詞
例子
rows: be subject to change、pertinent to the case

p2: 要注意：同一個字可以有兩種用法。eligible for + 名詞、eligible to + 原形動詞；entitled to + 名詞或原形動詞。看到 to 時，先確認後面是名詞還是動詞。
ex: Only full-time staff are ______ for the training subsidy.  (eligible / entitled / capable / aware)
後面是 for → eligible。entitled to、capable of、aware of 介系詞都不對。
Please send us any information ______ to the investigation.  (pertinent / indigenous / insolvent / inconspicuous)
pertinent to（與……有關的），是 Santa 收藏字。

notes.h: 近義字辨析：意思接近、情境不同
p: 下面幾組字中文都差不多，多益常放在同一題考。關鍵在「用在什麼情境」。

head: 一組字
差別
rows: fee / fare / fine / toll / surcharge / honorarium
fee 手續費、服務費；fare 交通工具的票價；fine 罰款；toll 過路費；surcharge 額外加收的費用（燃油附加費）；honorarium 給講者的酬金
rise 不及物（價格上漲）；raise 及物（提高價格、籌錢）；arise 問題「發生、出現」
backlog 累積未處理的工作（clear the backlog）；influx 大量湧入（an influx of tourists）
coincide with 同時發生；conform to 符合（標準）；comply with 遵守（規定）；culminate in 以……告終、達到頂點
impending 多半是不好的事即將發生（impending storm）；upcoming 中性（upcoming event）
robust 強勁的（robust sales）；lukewarm 冷淡、不熱烈的（lukewarm response）
until further notice、on short notice 是固定說法，只能用 notice
client 專業服務的客戶（律師、顧問）；customer 商店顧客；patron 餐廳、圖書館、劇院的常客

ex: Due to rising oil prices, a fuel ______ will be added to all international shipments.  (surcharge / fare / toll / honorarium)
額外加收的燃油費 → fuel surcharge。
The team worked overtime to clear the ______ of orders.  (backlog / influx / mishap / liaison)
clear the backlog（消化積壓的訂單）。influx 雖然也和數量多有關，但不能 clear。

notes.h: 形近字：長得像，意思不同
p: 這類題目是在測你有沒有看清楚字。速度快的人（你就是）最容易在這裡看錯，選之前把字再看一次。

head: 字
意思
常見搭配
rows: 經濟（方面）的／節省的、划算的
廣泛、豐富的／昂貴的／過多的
各自的／尊敬的／值得尊敬的

ex: Hotel guests receive ______ access to the fitness center.  (complimentary / complementary / compliant / comprehensive)
免費使用 → complimentary。complementary 是「互補的」。

p: 副詞選項意思都不同時，看它修飾的是什麼，以及句子裡的時間或程度線索。下面是固定和某些字一起出現的副詞。

head: 副詞
常見搭配
線索
rows: 後面有「日期可能改」之類的提示
程度很高（不能修飾動作）
暫時的，常搭配 during renovations
完全地，多修飾負面或極端的形容詞

ex: The launch has been ______ scheduled for June 2, pending final approval.  (tentatively / exclusively / previously / utterly)
pending final approval（等待最終核准）表示還沒確定 → tentatively（暫定地）。
notes.tip: nearly / almost 修飾數字和 all / every：almost all employees，不能說 most all。

p: 你在 Santa 收藏的單字裡，下面這些最常出現在 Part 5 的情境。背的時候連前後的字一起背，考試時看到搭配就能直接選。

head: 單字
多益常見的句子情境
rows: The contract stipulates that…（合約規定）
endorse a product / a candidate（代言、背書）
The job entails traveling…（需要、牽涉）
a discrepancy between the figures（不一致）
for the third consecutive year（連續第三年）
verify / present your credentials（資歷、證件）
undue delay / pressure（過度的、不當的）
The noise / demand subsided.（平息、減退）

notes.tip: 練習和測驗的題目大多用到這些字，有些當答案，有些當干擾選項。答完記得看每個選項的中文，順便複習。

cards.title: 詞彙題 4 步驟
points: 讀整句，圈出介系詞、受詞、邏輯詞（despite / because）
先刪文法不對的：後面接 that、to V、from V-ing 對不對
再刪搭配不對的：meet a deadline，不是 reach a deadline
剩下的代回句子比語意，選最自然的，不是最高級的
ex: Despite the ______ weather, the concert drew a record crowd.
Despite 表示前後相反，後面是好結果，前面要選負面的 unfavorable。

cards.title: 動詞句型陷阱
points: inform / notify / remind + 人 + that…；announce / explain 不能直接接人
urge / encourage / require / persuade + 人 + to V
suggest / recommend that + 主詞 + 原形動詞（不能接「人 + to V」）
prevent / prohibit / discourage + 人 + from V-ing
deem + 受詞 + 形容詞；regard / view + 受詞 + as
ex: The policy ______ visitors from parking here.  (prohibits / urges / permits)
from V-ing → prohibits。

cards.title: 動詞＋名詞固定搭配
points: meet a deadline / the demand / requirements
place an order、conduct a survey、reach an agreement
raise funds / concerns、address concerns / issues
waive a fee、solicit feedback、rectify an error
alleviate congestion、procure supplies、dispatch a technician
ex: The council is ______ feedback from residents.
solicit feedback（徵求意見）。

cards.title: 形容詞＋介系詞
points: eligible for、responsible for
entitled to、subject to、pertinent to、accessible to
compatible with、consistent with、familiar with
aware of、capable of
contingent on、dependent on
ex: Members are ______ to a 10% discount.  (entitled / eligible)
後面是 to + 名詞 → entitled。eligible 要接 for。

cards.title: 近義字、形近字
points: fee 手續費、fare 票價、fine 罰款、toll 過路費、surcharge 附加費
rise 不及物、raise 及物（raise funds）、arise 問題發生
backlog 積壓、influx 湧入；impending 不好的事即將發生
complimentary 免費／complementary 互補
confidential 機密／confident 自信；extensive 豐富／excessive 過多
ex: Guests receive ______ breakfast.
免費早餐 → complimentary。

cards.title: 副詞與固定說法
points: readily available、tentatively scheduled、strictly prohibited
highly recommended、conveniently located、temporarily closed
until further notice、on short notice（只能用 notice）
in accordance with（依照）、on behalf of（代表）、in charge of（負責）
for the third consecutive year（連續第三年）
ex: The gym will be closed until further ______.
固定說法 until further notice（直到另行通知）。

practice.q: Several well-known athletes have agreed to ______ the company's new line of running shoes.
practice.exp: 知名運動員和新款跑鞋 → 代言 endorse。procure 是公司去買，waive 接費用，impede 是阻礙，都不合句意。
practice.zh: 幾位知名運動員已同意替這家公司的新系列跑鞋代言。

practice.q: All employees are ______ to attend the safety briefing on Thursday morning.
practice.exp: 主詞是人 employees，be required to V（被要求做）。mandatory / essential / imperative 形容的是事情，例如 Attendance is mandatory、It is essential that…，不能說 employees are mandatory to attend。
practice.zh: 所有員工都必須參加星期四上午的安全說明會。

practice.q: The new warehouse will allow us to ______ the growing demand from overseas customers.
practice.exp: 固定搭配 meet the demand（滿足需求）。reach 接 agreement / goal，achieve 接 goal / success，gain 接 experience / profit。
practice.zh: 新倉庫能讓我們滿足海外客戶日益增加的需求。

practice.q: Due to rising oil prices, the shipping company has added a fuel ______ to all international orders.
practice.exp: 油價上漲而「額外加收」的費用 → fuel surcharge（燃油附加費）。fare 是乘客的票價，toll 是過路費，honorarium 是給講者的酬金。
practice.zh: 由於油價上漲，貨運公司對所有國際訂單加收燃油附加費。

practice.q: The manager ______ the staff that the office would be closed on Friday for maintenance.
practice.exp: 空格後面直接接人 the staff，再接 that 子句 → inform + 人 + that。announce / explain / say 都不能直接接人（要寫 announced to the staff that…）。
practice.zh: 經理通知員工，辦公室星期五因維修會關閉。

practice.q: Guests staying in the executive suites receive ______ breakfast and free access to the business lounge.
practice.exp: 後面的 free access 是線索，早餐也是免費的 → complimentary。complementary（互補的）只差一個字母，是最常見的形近字陷阱。
practice.zh: 入住行政套房的房客可享免費早餐，並可免費使用商務貴賓室。

practice.q: The accounting team worked over the weekend to ______ the billing error before the invoices were sent.
practice.exp: rectify an error（修正錯誤）是固定搭配。deem 要接受詞 + 形容詞，stipulate 接 that 子句，coincide 是不及物動詞（coincide with）。
practice.zh: 會計團隊週末加班，要在寄出發票前修正帳單錯誤。

practice.q: The updated user manual is ______ available on our Web site in five languages.
practice.exp: readily available（隨時可取得）是固定搭配。utterly 多修飾負面、極端的字，prudently 修飾花錢、投資，inadvertently 是不小心做錯事。
practice.zh: 更新後的使用手冊可以在我們的網站上隨時取得，共有五種語言。

practice.q: Despite the ______ weather conditions, the outdoor concert drew a record crowd.
practice.exp: Despite 表示前後相反：後面是好結果（創紀錄的人潮），前面要是負面的 → unfavorable。congenial 是正面的，用 despite 邏輯不通；unassuming 形容人，legible 形容字跡。
practice.zh: 儘管天氣狀況不佳，這場戶外音樂會仍吸引了創紀錄的人潮。

practice.q: Only employees who have worked here for at least six months are ______ for the annual bonus.
practice.exp: 看介系詞：be eligible for（有資格獲得）。entitled 要接 to，capable 接 of，aware 接 of。
practice.zh: 只有在這裡工作滿六個月的員工才有資格領年終獎金。

practice.q: The new parking policy will ______ visitors from leaving their cars in the loading zone.
practice.exp: 句型是「動詞 + 人 + from V-ing」→ prohibit（禁止）。urge / permit / encourage 都是「+ 人 + to V」。
practice.zh: 新的停車規定將禁止訪客把車停在裝卸區。

practice.q: Sales at the Busan branch have increased for five ______ quarters, making it the company's top-performing location.
practice.exp: for five consecutive quarters（連續五季）。impending 指即將到來（多半是壞事），lucrative 形容生意，explicit 形容說明、指示。
practice.zh: 釜山分店的業績已連續五季成長，成為公司表現最好的據點。

test.q: The contract ______ that all deliveries must be made within 30 days of the order date.
test.exp: 主詞是合約，後面接 that 子句寫條件 → stipulates（明文規定）。endorse / solicit / alleviate 都不接 that 子句。
test.zh: 合約規定所有貨品都必須在訂單日起 30 天內送達。

test.q: To ______ congestion during the morning rush hour, the city will add more buses to its downtown routes.
test.exp: 加開公車是為了「減輕」塞車 → alleviate congestion。impede 是阻礙，和塞車放在一起邏輯不通；revitalize 接 the economy / a neighborhood，dispatch 接人員或貨物。
test.zh: 為了緩解早上尖峰時段的交通壅塞，市政府將在市中心路線加開公車。

test.q: Ms. Romero ______ that the team postpone the product launch until the software issues are resolved.
test.exp: 空格後面是 that + 主詞 + 原形動詞（postpone 沒加 s）→ recommend that…。persuade / encourage / allow 要接「人 + to V」。
test.zh: 羅梅洛小姐建議團隊延後產品上市，直到軟體問題解決為止。

test.q: The marketing department will ______ a survey to find out how customers feel about the new packaging.
test.exp: conduct a survey（進行調查）是固定搭配。undergo 是「接受」檢查或改變，attend 接會議，proceed 是不及物動詞（proceed with）。
test.zh: 行銷部將進行一項調查，了解顧客對新包裝的看法。

test.q: Because the documents contain ______ financial information, they must be stored in a locked cabinet.
test.exp: 要鎖起來保存的財務資料 → confidential（機密的）。confident 形容人有自信，considerate 是體貼，都是形近字陷阱。
test.zh: 因為這些文件含有機密的財務資訊，必須存放在上鎖的櫃子裡。

test.q: Despite a slowdown in other sectors, demand for electric vehicles remained ______ throughout the year.
test.exp: Despite 表示對比：其他產業放緩，電動車需求卻「依然強勁」→ robust。lukewarm demand 雖然是真的搭配，但和 despite 的對比邏輯相反。
test.zh: 儘管其他產業放緩，電動車的需求一整年都依然強勁。

test.q: ______ the company's travel policy, employees must book economy-class tickets for flights under five hours.
test.exp: 「依照」公司差旅規定 → in accordance with。on behalf of 是代表某人，in charge of 是負責某事，in favor of 是贊成，放在這裡句意不通。
test.zh: 依照公司的差旅規定，五小時以內的航班員工必須訂經濟艙。

test.q: The customer service team has hired temporary staff to clear the ______ of unanswered e-mails.
test.exp: clear the backlog（消化積壓的工作）。influx 雖然也是「很多」，但指湧入的過程，不能 clear；mishap 是小意外，liaison 是聯絡人。
test.zh: 客服團隊聘請了臨時人員來消化積壓的未回覆電子郵件。

test.q: The opening of the new branch has been ______ scheduled for May 3, but the date may change depending on construction progress.
test.exp: 後半句說日期可能會變 → 暫定 tentatively scheduled。exclusively、previously、utterly 都和「可能改期」接不上。
test.zh: 新分店的開幕暫定在 5 月 3 日，但日期可能依工程進度調整。

test.q: The release of the band's new album was timed to ______ with the start of its world tour.
test.exp: 專輯發行時間安排成和巡演「同時」→ coincide with。conform 接 to，culminate 接 in；comply with 雖然介系詞對，但意思是遵守規定，不合句意。
test.zh: 樂團新專輯的發行時間，特意安排在世界巡演開始時。

test.q: Please attach any documents ______ to your claim, such as receipts or repair estimates.
test.exp: documents pertinent to your claim（與你的申請相關的文件）。pertinent to 是固定用法，其他三個字意思都不合。
test.zh: 請附上所有與你的理賠申請相關的文件，例如收據或維修估價單。

test.q: The east entrance will remain closed until further ______ while the elevators are being replaced.
test.exp: until further notice（直到另行通知）是固定說法，只能用 notice。notification、announcement 意思接近，但不能放進這個片語。
test.zh: 電梯更換期間，東側入口將關閉，直到另行通知為止。

test.q: The safety inspector ______ the old bridge unsafe and ordered it closed to traffic.
test.exp: 受詞 the old bridge 後面直接接形容詞 unsafe → deem + 受詞 + 形容詞。regard / view 要加 as，refer 要用 refer to … as。
test.zh: 安全檢查員判定這座舊橋不安全，下令禁止車輛通行。

test.q: The city council is ______ feedback from residents on the proposed changes to the park.
test.exp: solicit feedback（徵求意見）是固定搭配。engrave 是刻字，irrigate 是灌溉，reclaim 是收回（行李、土地）。
test.zh: 市議會正在徵求居民對公園改建提案的意見。

test.q: Applicants for the position should have ______ experience in project management, preferably in the construction industry.
test.exp: 徵才條件 → extensive experience（豐富的經驗）。excessive 是「過多」，帶負面意思，不會當成應徵條件；expensive、exclusive 是形近字陷阱。
test.zh: 應徵這個職位的人應具備豐富的專案管理經驗，最好是在營建業。

p: Part 7 共 54 題，其中單篇約 29 題（10 篇左右），多篇 25 題。你的 Santa 數據顯示 Part 7 平均每題 36 秒，比建議的 1 分鐘快很多，正確率 83% 也不差。所以這一章的重點不是加速，而是你兩個 47.3% 的弱點：「心得感想類文章」和「簡述語意（同義改寫）」。
先認出文章類型，就知道該注意什麼：
steps: 先看文章類型（標題、格式）：email、公告、廣告、評論、簡訊聊天、文章。知道類型就知道重點在哪。
看第一題，帶著問題讀文章。題目順序大致跟文章順序一致。
找到答案所在的句子後，回選項找「意思相同、用字不同」的那一個。
NOT 題和推論題比較花時間，可以先做完同一篇的其他題再回來。
選之前問自己：這個答案文章裡找得到根據嗎？找不到就不選。

head: 文章類型
常考什麼
rows: 寫信目的、對方要做什麼、附件、期限
對誰說、要改變什麼、什麼時候開始
優惠內容、限制條件、怎麼取得
喜歡什麼、不滿什麼、會不會推薦（你的弱點）
說話者意圖、下一步誰做什麼
主旨、原因、引述的人說了什麼

notes.tip: 題目問 mainly about / purpose 時看第一段；問細節時用題目裡的人名、數字、日期當關鍵字回文章找。

notes.h: 同義改寫：正確答案很少照抄原文
p: 這是你 Santa 的弱點（簡述語意 47.3%）。Part 7 的正確答案幾乎都會把原文「換句話說」，而照抄原文字詞的選項，常常是陷阱：字對了，但講的是另一件事。
下面是多益最常見的改寫，左邊是文章的寫法，右邊是選項的寫法：

head: 文章裡
選項裡
rows: send the slides / attach the document
free of charge / at no cost / complimentary
relocate / move to a new site
lent me a charger I forgot
provided an item he had forgotten

p2: 改寫有三種方式：換同義字（reimburse → pay back）、換說法（lasts a week on a single charge → does not need to be charged often），以及抽象化（laptop charger → an item）。第三種最常讓人選錯，因為選項看起來跟原文「不像」。
ex: Article: "Our current plant is running at full capacity."  Option: Its existing plant cannot produce any more.
running at full capacity（滿載運轉）＝ cannot produce any more。用字完全不同，意思相同。
notes.tip: 練習方法：每次答對後，回頭找出原文那一句，在心裡把「原文 → 選項」配對一次。這一章每題的解析都會寫出這組對照。

notes.h: 心得感想類文章（你的 Santa 弱點）
p: 這類文章包括：顧客評論（review）、推薦文（testimonial）、問卷意見、部落格心得，以及新聞裡引述的個人看法。難的地方是：同一篇裡正面和負面混在一起，而且負面常常講得很委婉。
讀的時候在心裡把每一句標成「＋」或「－」，特別注意下面這些轉折訊號：

head: 訊號
後面通常接
rows: My only complaint / The only drawback
My only wish is… / I wish…
希望改進的地方（委婉的批評）
did not disappoint / could not have been better
I was doubtful / skeptical at first, but…
推薦給 X，不推薦給 Y

p2: 常考的題目：reviewer 喜歡什麼、抱怨什麼、對誰推薦、下次會不會再用、關於 reviewer 本人可以推論什麼（出差？常客？）。
steps: 先看評論是誰寫的、身分是什麼（職業、為什麼使用這個產品）。
每段找出「＋」和「－」，轉折詞後面特別小心。
選項說「做得差」時，回去確認原文是「做得差」還是「沒有提供」。這是最常見的陷阱。
ex: "I signed up mainly for the e-mail module, and it did not disappoint."
did not disappoint 是雙重否定＝很滿意。不要看到 disappoint 就以為是負面。

p: 題目有 NOT 時（What is NOT mentioned / NOT true / NOT included），四個選項裡有三個文章裡找得到，要選找不到或相反的那個。題目問 What is indicated / stated / true about… 時則相反，四個裡只有一個找得到。
steps: 先把四個選項的關鍵字記下來。
回文章逐一打勾，找到一個刪一個。
NOT 題的答案常是「看起來很合理、但文章沒寫」的東西（例如飯店的免費早餐）。不要用常識判斷。
notes.tip: NOT 題比較花時間，你的速度有餘裕，值得每個選項都確實對照。

p: 推論題的答案文章沒有直接寫，但一定可以從某一兩句「推得出來」。錯誤選項通常是推過頭，或用了文章裡的字卻講錯對象。

head: 題目問法
怎麼找
rows: What is suggested about Mr. X?
找所有提到 X 的句子，看能合理推出什麼（身分、目的、下一步）
Who most likely is Ms. Y?
看她的職稱、做的事、說話對象
What will Z most likely do next?
看最後幾句：誰答應做什麼（Will do、I'll…）
把兩處數字合起來算（要 200、有 120 → 補 80）

ex: "I stayed here while attending a trade fair… I would happily stay here again on my next business trip."
推得出：他是出差。推不出：他以前住過（would stay again 是未來）。

notes.h: 意圖題：簡訊和線上聊天
p: 題目引用一句話問「寫這句是什麼意思」（What does X mean when she writes, "…"?）。這句話單獨看通常有好幾種意思，一定要看前一句和後一句。

head: 常考的句子
常見的意思
rows: Consider it done. / I'm on it. / Will do.
我會處理（答應對方的要求）
問題重複發生，感到無奈
同意提議的時間或做法
對方提醒了自己沒想到的事
I'll take care of it. / Leave it to me.
Let me look. / Let me check.
我去確認一下（還不知道答案）

notes.tip: 多人聊天（三人以上）要特別記清楚誰答應做什麼。「下一步誰做什麼」是必考題，你的 3 人對話也是 Santa 弱點。

p: 同義字題：The word "raised" in paragraph 4 is closest in meaning to…。這類題目考的幾乎都是多義字，四個選項通常都是這個字的某個意思，只有一個放回原句是通的。一定要把選項代回原句。

head: 字
常考的意思
例子
rows: the terms of the contract → conditions

p2: 插入句題：In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? 要找句子裡「指向前文」的線索：代名詞（it、they、each one）、指示詞（this、these、such）、連接副詞（also、however、as a result、in addition），然後找它指的東西在哪一句。
ex: "Most of these positions will be in production and packaging."
these positions 要接在提到工作的句子後面：The factory will create approximately 350 jobs. [2]

cards.title: 單篇閱讀 4 步驟
points: 先看文章類型：email、公告、評論、聊天、文章
帶著題目讀，題目順序大致跟文章順序一致
找到根據句，再找「意思相同、用字不同」的選項
照抄原文字詞的選項要小心，常是陷阱
ex: Option: "They provided an item he had forgotten."
原文是 lent me a laptop charger I had left at home。抽象化改寫最常被忽略。

cards.title: 同義改寫對照
points: no later than → by；postpone → delay
free of charge / complimentary → at no cost
reimburse → pay back；relocate → move
running at full capacity → cannot produce more
sold out → no longer available；recruit → hire
ex: the battery lasts a full week on a single charge
＝ It does not need to be charged often.

cards.title: 心得感想文章
points: 每句標「＋」或「－」
That said / However / Although 後面是相反意見
My only complaint / My only wish → 唯一的缺點
did not disappoint / could not have been better → 很滿意
「沒有提供」不等於「做得很差」
ex: For commuting, absolutely. For anything longer, I would look at other models.
推薦給通勤族，不推薦長途使用。

cards.title: NOT 題與推論題
points: NOT：三個找得到，選找不到的
選項逐一回文章打勾，不用常識判斷
推論：答案要能從一兩句推得出來
推過頭、或用對字講錯對象的選項是陷阱
數字題可能要把兩處資訊合起來算
ex: 要 200 個藍色，只有 120 個，剩下用黑色
→ 黑色會補 80 個

cards.title: 意圖題（簡訊、聊天）
points: 一定看前一句和後一句
Consider it done / Will do / I'm on it → 答應處理
Again? → 問題重複發生
Good point → 對方提醒了沒想到的事
多人聊天：記清楚誰答應做什麼
ex: Grace, could you contact IT?  —  Will do.
下一步：Grace 聯絡 IT。

cards.title: 同義字與插入句
points: 同義字題考多義字，選項代回原句
raised concerns → expressed；address an issue → deal with
插入句找代名詞、指示詞：it、these、such、each one
也看連接副詞：also、however、as a result
找到它指的東西，句子就放在那句後面
ex: "Most of these positions…"
these positions → 放在 350 jobs 那句後面。

practice.q: What does Mr. Okafor say about the hotel staff?
opts: They provided an item he had forgotten.
They upgraded his room at no cost.
They helped him carry his luggage.
practice.exp: 原文：I had left my laptop charger at home, the front desk lent me one → 改寫成 provided an item he had forgotten。free of charge 出現在原文，但指的是借充電器，不是升級房間；照抄原文字的選項常是陷阱。
practice.zh: 題目：歐卡佛先生對飯店員工有什麼評價？ ／ 答案：他們提供了一樣他忘了帶的東西。
optsZh: 他們提供了一樣他忘了帶的東西。
他們免費幫他升級房間。
他們推薦了附近的餐廳。

practice.q: What is one of Mr. Okafor's complaints?
opts: The fitness center closes too early.
The room was smaller than expected.
The hotel is far from the convention center.
The Internet did not work in the lobby.
practice.exp: My only real complaint concerns the fitness center. It closes at 8 P.M., which is far too early。Wi-Fi 慢的是房間，大廳反而 worked well enough，所以 D 錯。
practice.zh: 題目：歐卡佛先生的抱怨之一是什麼？ ／ 答案：健身中心太早關門。

practice.q: What is suggested about Mr. Okafor?
opts: He has stayed at the hotel before.
He works at the convention center.
He ate all of his meals at the hotel.
practice.exp: attending a trade fair（參加商展）、my next business trip → 推論他是出差。would stay here again 是「會再住」，不代表以前住過。
practice.zh: 題目：關於歐卡佛先生，文中暗示了什麼？ ／ 答案：他是來出差的。

practice.q: What is NOT mentioned as a positive feature of the hotel?
practice.exp: NOT 題要逐一對照：location could not have been better（地點）、spotless（整潔）、bed was extremely comfortable（床）。早餐完全沒提到。
practice.zh: 題目：哪一項「沒有」被提到是飯店的優點？ ／ 答案：免費早餐。

practice.q: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
opts: To give staff information about an office move
To announce the opening of a new branch
To ask employees to vote on a new location
To explain changes to a lease agreement
practice.exp: 主旨題看第一段和標題：Subject: Office move、we will relocate to… 後面整封信都在講打包和停車 → 說明搬遷安排。lease 只是搬家的原因。
practice.zh: 題目：這封 email 的目的是什麼？ ／ 答案：向員工說明搬遷辦公室的相關資訊。
optsZh: 向員工說明搬辦公室的安排

practice.q: What are employees asked to do?
opts: Pack the items at their own workstations
Pack the supplies in the kitchen
Order boxes from a moving company
Visit the new office before June 23
practice.exp: each employee is responsible for packing the contents of his or her own desk → 改寫成 items at their own workstations。廚房是搬家工人負責；箱子會送到各部門，不用自己訂。
practice.zh: 題目：員工被要求做什麼？ ／ 答案：打包自己座位上的物品。
optsZh: 打包自己座位上的物品
在 6 月 23 日前參觀新辦公室

practice.q: What is indicated about parking permits?
opts: Employees will be paid back for them.
They are free for building tenants.
They are issued by Ms. Nair.
They must be shared by two employees.
practice.exp: the cost will be reimbursed by the company → reimburse（報銷）改寫成 be paid back。許可證是向大樓管理處申請，不是奈爾小姐。
practice.zh: 題目：關於停車許可證，文中提到什麼？ ／ 答案：公司會把費用退還給員工。
optsZh: 公司會把費用還給員工。
大樓的承租戶可以免費取得。

practice.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Please make sure each one is clearly marked with your name and department."
practice.exp: 句子裡的 each one 要指前面剛提到的東西：Boxes and labels will be delivered… 之後接「請確認每個箱子都標上姓名和部門」最順，所以放 [2]。插入句題先找代名詞和指示詞（it、this、each one、these）指的是什麼。
practice.zh: 插入句：「請確認每一個（箱子）都清楚標上你的姓名和部門。」

practice.q: At 9:36 A.M., what does Mr. Patel most likely mean when he writes, "Consider it done"?
opts: He will make sure the order is prepared as requested.
He has already shipped the order.
He thinks the client's request is unreasonable.
He wants Ms. Cho to update the packing list.
practice.exp: 意圖題看前後句：前一句客戶同意用黑色補足、只要週五前送達；後面他說 I'll update the packing list now → 表示「交給我，會照辦」。done 不是真的已經寄出。
practice.zh: 題目：上午 9:36，帕特爾先生寫「就當作已經辦好了」最可能是什麼意思？ ／ 答案：他會確保訂單照要求準備好。
optsZh: 他會確保訂單照要求準備好。
他覺得客戶的要求不合理。
他要趙小姐更新裝箱單。

practice.q: Why did Ms. Cho contact Mr. Patel?
opts: To tell him about a change to an order
To ask him to deliver folders to a client
To confirm the price of some folders
practice.exp: 第一則訊息：They want 200 more blue folders added to Friday's shipment → 訂單內容改變（加量）。
practice.zh: 題目：趙小姐為什麼聯絡帕特爾先生？ ／ 答案：告訴他訂單有變動。
optsZh: 請他把資料夾送去給客戶

practice.q: What did the client agree to?
opts: Receiving some items in a different color
Reducing the size of the order
practice.exp: I'll ask if they'd accept black for the rest → They said that's fine → 同意剩下的用黑色（different color）。日期反而堅持要週五前到。
practice.zh: 題目：客戶同意了什麼？ ／ 答案：收到部分不同顏色的商品。
optsZh: 收到部分不同顏色的商品

practice.q: How many black folders will most likely be added to the shipment?
practice.exp: 要 200 個，藍色只有 120 個，剩下的用黑色補：200 − 120 = 80。Part 7 偶爾會考這種要把兩句資訊合起來的推論。
practice.zh: 題目：這批貨最可能會加進多少個黑色資料夾？ ／ 答案：80 個。

test.q: What does Ms. Lindqvist suggest about the workshop?
opts: She would have liked it to last longer.
It was too difficult for her.
Her manager recommended it to her.
It focused mainly on e-mail writing.
test.exp: My only wish is that the course had been a week longer → 希望課程更長。manager 只是「注意到她的進步」，不是推薦她上課。
test.zh: 題目：林德奎斯特小姐對這個工作坊有什麼看法？ ／ 答案：她希望課程能再長一點。
optsZh: 她希望課程能再長一點。
是她的主管推薦她來上的。

test.q: What criticism does Mr. Mori make?
opts: Part of the content was too elementary.
The instructor was not available after class.
The class size was too large.
test.exp: That said（話雖如此）是轉折訊號，後面才是批評：the grammar review… too basic → 改寫成 too elementary。it did not disappoint 是稱讚 email 單元，C 剛好相反。
test.zh: 題目：森先生提出了什麼批評？ ／ 答案：部分內容太基礎。

test.q: What is indicated about Ms. Petit?
opts: She plans to continue studying at Northbridge.
She works for a translation company.
She took the workshop in September.
test.exp: I have already enrolled in the advanced level → 會繼續上進階課。她是 freelance（自由接案）譯者，不屬於公司；九月是進階班開課時間。
test.zh: 題目：關於佩蒂小姐，文中提到什麼？ ／ 答案：她打算繼續在 Northbridge 進修。
optsZh: 她打算繼續在 Northbridge 進修。
她是在九月上這個工作坊。

test.q: What is NOT mentioned as a benefit of the workshop?
test.exp: 逐一對照：individual feedback on every assignment（B）、structuring long documents（C）、stay after class to answer questions（D）。證書沒有提到。
test.zh: 題目：哪一項「沒有」被提到是這個工作坊的好處？ ／ 答案：結業證書。
optsZh: 每份作業都有個別回饋

test.q: What is the article mainly about?
opts: A company's plan to increase its production
The opening of a vegetarian restaurant
A change in a company's leadership
Road repairs planned by the city
test.exp: 第一段：will build a second factory → 蓋第二座工廠＝提高產能。素食料理和道路改善都只是細節。
test.zh: 題目：這篇文章主要在講什麼？ ／ 答案：一家公司提高產能的計畫。
optsZh: 一家公司提高產能的計畫
市政府規劃的道路整修

test.q: Why is Halvorsen Foods building a new factory?
opts: Its existing plant cannot produce any more.
The lease on its current plant is ending.
It wants to lower its transportation costs.
Local officials asked it to move.
test.exp: Our current plant is running at full capacity（現有工廠已滿載）→ 改寫成 cannot produce any more。
test.zh: 題目：Halvorsen 食品為什麼要蓋新工廠？ ／ 答案：現有的工廠已經無法再增加產量。
optsZh: 現有的工廠已經無法再增加產量。
現在工廠的租約快到期了。

test.q: The word "raised" in paragraph 4, line 1, is closest in meaning to
test.exp: 同義字題要代回原句看意思：raised concerns 是「提出疑慮」→ expressed。increased、lifted 是 raise 的其他意思，放進句子不通。
test.zh: 題目：第 4 段第 1 行的 raised 意思最接近哪個字？ ／ 答案：expressed（提出）。

test.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Most of these positions will be in production and packaging."
test.exp: these positions（這些職缺）要接在提到工作的句子後面：The factory will create approximately 350 jobs. [2] → 放 [2]。
test.zh: 插入句：「這些職缺大多是在生產和包裝部門。」

test.q: At 2:03 P.M., what does Ms. Reyes most likely mean when she writes, "Again?"
opts: She is frustrated that the problem keeps happening.
She did not hear what Mr. Brooks said.
She thinks the meeting should be canceled.
She believes the projector was just replaced.
test.exp: 前一句是 stopped working again，接著布魯克斯說 I know，後面還要請 IT 換掉而不是 repairing it again → 問題反覆發生，Again? 表示無奈。
test.zh: 題目：下午 2:03，雷耶斯小姐寫「又壞了？」最可能是什麼意思？ ／ 答案：她對問題一再發生感到無奈。
optsZh: 她對問題一再發生感到無奈。
她沒聽到布魯克斯先生說什麼。
她認為投影機才剛換過。

test.q: Why is Room D unsuitable for the meeting?
opts: It cannot hold all of the expected attendees.
It does not have a projector.
test.exp: Room D only seats eight people… a team of ten → 人數超過容量。open until 5:00 講的是董事會議室。
test.zh: 題目：為什麼 D 會議室不適合開這場會？ ／ 答案：容納不下所有預計出席的人。
optsZh: 容納不下所有預計出席的人。

test.q: What will Ms. Lin most likely do next?
opts: Ask the technology department to replace some equipment
test.exp: 布魯克斯請她 contact IT about replacing that projector，她回 Will do。預約和通知櫃檯是布魯克斯自己要做的事。
test.zh: 題目：林小姐接下來最可能做什麼？ ／ 答案：請 IT 部門更換設備。
optsZh: 請 IT 部門更換設備

test.q: What does Ms. Weber say about the battery?
opts: It does not need to be charged often.
It takes two hours to charge.
It stopped working after a month.
test.exp: lasts a full week of commuting on a single charge（充一次電撐一整週）→ 不用常充電。two hours 是頭帶開始不舒服的時間；一個月後鬆脫的是耳墊。
test.zh: 題目：韋伯小姐對電池有什麼看法？ ／ 答案：不需要常常充電。

test.q: What disadvantage of the headphones does Ms. Weber mention?
opts: They become uncomfortable when worn for a long time.
They do not block out much noise.
They are too heavy to carry on a train.
Their carrying case is poorly made.
test.exp: That said 後面是缺點：The headband becomes uncomfortable after about two hours。收納盒是「沒有附」，不是「做得差」，這是心得文常見的陷阱。
test.zh: 題目：韋伯小姐提到這副耳機的什麼缺點？ ／ 答案：戴久了會不舒服。

test.q: What is indicated about Voxa's customer service?
opts: It sent a replacement part at no cost.
It refunded the cost of the headphones.
It took several weeks to respond.
test.exp: A replacement arrived within three days, and I was not charged anything → 改寫成 sent a replacement part at no cost。
test.zh: 題目：關於 Voxa 的客服，文中提到什麼？ ／ 答案：免費寄來替換零件。

test.q: For whom would Ms. Weber most likely recommend the Q7?
opts: People who make short daily trips to work
People who often take long flights
People who want a carrying case included
test.exp: 結尾：For commuting, absolutely. For anything longer, I would look at other models → 推薦給通勤族。長途飛行她明確說不推薦。
test.zh: 題目：韋伯小姐最可能把 Q7 推薦給誰？ ／ 答案：每天短程通勤上班的人。
optsZh: 每天短程通勤上班的人

p: Part 3 共 39 題（13 段對話，每段 3 題），Part 4 共 30 題（10 段獨白）。你的 Santa 數據 Part 3 是 83、Part 4 是 84，整體不差；真正掉分的是「3 人對話」只有 47.3%（750 分平均 67.5%）。所以這一章的重點是：三人對話怎麼分辨誰是誰，再加上看圖作答和說話者意圖題。
每段的 3 題有固定的出題位置：

head: 題目
常問什麼
答案大概在
rows: 主旨、目的、地點、說話者的職業（What are the speakers discussing? / Where…? / Who most likely…?）
問題、原因、細節、意圖題（What problem…? / Why…?）
下一步、建議、提議（What will…do next? / What does…suggest / offer?）

steps: 音檔開始前，先預讀這一段的 3 個題幹（選項掃一眼就好），圈出 the man / the women / 人名、Look at the graphic、引號裡的句子。
邊聽邊作答：三題的答案大致照對話順序出現。
聽到答案就先選，不要等全部聽完再回想。
音檔一結束，馬上把剩下的題目選掉，接著預讀下一段的題目。能不能預讀，比作答速度更重要。
notes.tip: 這個 App 會把同一段的三個題幹列在上方，對話開始時請先把三題看完，養成預讀的習慣。

notes.h: 三人對話：先搞清楚誰是誰
p: 三人對話的題目會出現 the men / the women（複數），或直接用人名（What does Raj suggest?）。難的通常不是聽不懂，而是聽懂了卻對錯人。
對話裡一定會留下分辨說話者的線索：

head: 線索
例子
怎麼用
rows: Kevin, Raj, do you have a minute?
說這句的人是第三個人，不是被叫的那兩位
Priya, you're the one at the front desk.
下一個開口的就是被叫的人
Sam from our supplier is here to explain.
下一個新聲音就是 Sam
不用分辨，直接聽她說的話
What do the men agree to do?
兩人一前一後接話、都同意的事

p2: 三人對話很常見的結構：
steps: 第一個人帶出問題或消息。
第二個人提出疑慮或補充，常用 But… / …though / That would mean…。
第三個人提出解決辦法，What if… / If we… 後面常是 suggest 題的答案。
最後誰說 I'll…，就是「誰會做什麼」題的答案，一定要對到人名。
notes.tip: 答完看逐字稿，確認每一句是誰說的。三人題答錯，多半是把 A 說的話當成 B 說的。

p: 三人對話裡，一個人說完，另一個人馬上接話。代名詞 it / them / that 指的常是上一位說話者提到的東西，要往回對。

head: 接話信號
意思
對應題型
rows: That would mean… / The thing is… / …though
What if… / Why don't we… / How about…

ex: Raj, that would mean asking the trainers to stay for the whole day, though. — I'll call them this afternoon.
them 指上一句的 trainers；被叫名字的拉吉接話，所以是拉吉要聯絡講師。
I'll need the cancellation data from the last two quarters. — I'll ask Hiro to send it to you today.
it 指 the cancellation data，男子要請廣志寄資料。
notes.tip: 聽到 But、though、Actually，後面幾乎都是考點：原本的計畫被推翻，答案在後面。

notes.h: 看圖作答（Look at the graphic）
p: 每份考卷約有 5 題（Part 3 約 3 題、Part 4 約 2 題）。圖表可能是時刻表、價目表、樓層指南、地圖、長條圖、天氣預報或優惠券。
最重要的規則：選項列的是圖表上的「某一欄」，對話講的卻是「另一欄」。例如選項是會議室名稱，對話只說「最大間」「有視訊的那間」。

head: 選項是
對話會講
rows: 幾天完成、要更快的（faster option）
第幾大、比例、能不能改變

steps: 看選項是圖表的哪一欄（名稱？價格？時間？）。
找圖表的其他欄位，那就是對話會講的線索。
聽到被否定的就劃掉：too late、that's out、doesn't have…。
遇到互換、延後、取消、第二名（next biggest），先在圖上自己調整再選。
notes.tip: 圖表題最常見的陷阱：最先被提到、後來被推翻的那一格。聽到 Hmm / Actually / that's too late，就要換答案了。

notes.h: 說話者意圖題（Why does the man say "…"?）
p: Part 3 約 2 題、Part 4 約 3 題。引號裡的句子單看字面常有兩三種解釋，答案取決於前一句在講什麼。

head: 句子
字面
常見的真正意思
rows: 對不尋常的事感到意外
That's the least of our worries.
那不是重點，有更大的問題

steps: 預讀時把引號裡的句子先讀一遍，想好兩種可能的意思。
聽到那句時，注意前一句對方說了什麼。
再聽後一句怎麼接，常是最好的證據。
照字面翻譯的選項通常是錯的（例如 He wants to be the first to deliver）。
notes.tip: I've heard that before 之後對方說 Fair enough（可以理解），就證明那句是在質疑。

p: 獨白只有一個人，不用分辨誰是誰，但資訊比較密。先從開頭認出類型：

head: 類型
開頭
常考
rows: Hi, this is … I'm calling about …
打來的目的、出了什麼問題、要聽者做什麼
變更（延誤、換登機門）、聽者該怎麼做
議程變更、提醒事項、抽獎或優惠
賣什麼、優惠條件、怎麼取得
主題、原因、接下來會怎樣

p2: 第 3 題常問「聽眾被要求做什麼」，答案在 please / don't forget / be sure to 的後面。
notes.tip: 你的 Part 4 是 84 分，比 750 分平均（57）高很多，這部分以維持手感為主。

notes.h: 換句話說：正確選項不會照抄
p: 跟 Part 7 一樣，正確選項幾乎都改寫過；照抄對話字詞的選項常是陷阱。這一章題目裡出現過的改寫：

head: 聽到
選項寫
rows: reserved for two groups at once
display them at an industry event
we won't be charging you a delivery fee
push the tasting back to next week
ordered from us every month for two years

notes.tip: 聽到的字在選項裡原封不動出現時，先懷疑它是干擾，再確認意思對不對。

notes.h: 練習方法（針對 3 人對話 47.3%）
p: 這一章每段對話只自動播一次，第一題念完才開始倒數，後兩題直接倒數（每題 20 秒）。答完可以按「重播音檔」再聽，打開「看逐字稿和中譯」核對每一句是誰說的。
steps: 第一輪：正常作答，不看逐字稿。
答錯的那一段：打開逐字稿，在每一句前面標出說話者的名字，再重播一次。
第二輪：只聽不看題目，聽完說出「三個人各想要什麼、最後誰要做什麼」。
每天 1–2 段三人對話，連續兩週，再回 Santa 看 3 人對話的正確率有沒有上來。
notes.tip: 不同說話者會用不同聲音念：女聲、男聲；同性別的第二位會換口音或音高。如果裝置上的英文語音很少，聲音會比較像，這時更要靠叫名字的線索。

cards.title: Part 3/4 作答節奏
points: 音檔開始前，先預讀三個題幹
答案照對話順序出現：第 1 題前段、第 3 題最後
聽到答案就先選，不要等聽完再回想
一段結束，馬上預讀下一段
ex: Q1 主旨・地點 → Q2 問題・細節 → Q3 下一步・建議
第 3 題的答案多在最後兩三句

cards.title: 三人對話：誰是誰
points: 開頭叫兩個名字的人，是第三個人
回話時叫名字，下一個開口的就是他
介紹別人之後，下一個新聲音就是被介紹的人
I'll… 是誰說的，一定要對到人名
ex: Kevin, Raj, do you have a minute?
說這句的是梅根；Kevin 和 Raj 是另外兩人

cards.title: 接話信號
points: though / That would mean… → 反對、指出問題
What if… / Why don't we… → 建議
I'll… / Let me… → 這個人要去做
Good point / In that case → 決定改變了
ex: Raj, that would mean asking the trainers to stay all day, though.
though＝提出問題；被叫名字的拉吉才是提議的人

cards.title: 看圖作答
points: 選項是圖表的一欄，對話講的是另一欄
聽到被否定的（too late / that's out）就劃掉
互換、延後、第二名：先在圖上自己調整
陷阱＝先被提到、後來被推翻的那一格
ex: Let's just book the largest one.
對話沒說 Oak，要用「最大間」去圖上找

cards.title: 說話者意圖
points: 看引號句的前一句，對方剛說了什麼
再聽後一句怎麼接，最好的證據
照字面翻譯的選項通常是錯的
常考：I've heard that before / That's a first / It's not my call
ex: I've heard that before.
對方剛保證不會出錯 → 表示懷疑

cards.title: 換句話說
points: discontinued → no longer being made
in stock → available right away
push back → reschedule / postpone
won't charge → waive a fee
ex: Option: "A product is no longer being made."
原文是 the manufacturer has stopped producing the oak pattern

practice.q: What problem does the woman mention?
opts: A room has been reserved for two groups at once.
A registration deadline has been missed.
The conference center will be closed for repairs.
The cost of a venue has increased.
practice.exp: double-booked → reserved for two groups at once。三人對話的第一題通常在第一位說話者的前兩句就給答案，邊聽邊選。
practice.zh: 題目：女子提到什麼問題？ ／ 答案：一間會議室同時訂給了兩組人。
optsZh: 一間會議室同時訂給了兩組人。

practice.q: What does Raj suggest?
practice.exp: 提議的人是誰？下一位男聲回應時叫了 Raj，所以提出拆場次的是拉吉。他說 split the workshop into a morning session and an afternoon session → two smaller sessions。注意凱文只是提出疑慮，不是建議。
practice.zh: 題目：拉吉建議什麼？ ／ 答案：分成兩個人數較少的場次。
optsZh: 分成兩個人數較少的場次

practice.q: What does Raj say he will do this afternoon?
practice.exp: I'll call them this afternoon → them 指上一句的 trainers（凱文提到 asking the trainers）。代名詞要往回對到前一位說話者講的名詞，這是三人對話最常出錯的地方。打給會議中心的是梅根。
practice.zh: 題目：拉吉說他今天下午會做什麼？ ／ 答案：聯絡講師。

practice.q: Why does the woman need the brochures?
opts: She will display them at an industry event.
She will mail them to new clients.
She will hand them out at a training session.
She will include them in a product package.
practice.exp: exhibiting at an industry fair → display them at an industry event。fair、exhibition、trade show、expo 都是同一類，選項常換成更抽象的 event。
practice.zh: 題目：女子為什麼需要這些手冊？ ／ 答案：她要在一場產業活動上展示。
optsZh: 她要在一場產業活動上展示。
她要在訓練課程上發放。

practice.q: Look at the graphic. How much will the woman most likely pay?
practice.exp: 男子先提兩天的 Express（星期三下午六點），女子說 too late、go with the faster option → 比兩天更快的只有 Overnight，$260。圖表題的陷阱就是「先被提到、後來被否定」的那一格（$185）。
practice.zh: 題目：看圖表。女子最可能付多少錢？ ／ 答案：260 美元。

practice.q: What does the man offer to do?
opts: Send a sample for the woman to approve
Deliver the order to the airport
Give the woman a discount on a future order
Print some extra copies at no charge
practice.exp: send you a proof … so you can check the colors → a sample for the woman to approve。proof（樣張、校稿）是多益常考字。最後一題常問 offer / suggest / will do，答案在最後兩句。
practice.zh: 題目：男子提議做什麼？ ／ 答案：寄樣張給女子確認。

practice.q: Why is the speaker calling?
opts: To explain a change to a delivery
practice.exp: I'm calling about tomorrow's delivery，接著說冷藏車壞了、改成分兩批送 → explain a change to a delivery。電話留言的第一題（目的）答案幾乎都在 I'm calling about / I'm calling to 這句之後。
practice.zh: 題目：說話者為什麼打電話？ ／ 答案：說明送貨的變動。

practice.q: Why does the speaker say, "Is that cutting it close for your kitchen staff"?
opts: To check whether the staff would still have enough time to prepare
To suggest that the staff work later than usual
To complain that the staff arrived late
practice.exp: 前一句：剩下的食材下午四點才到，而宴會在晚上 → cutting it close（時間很趕）是在問這樣準備時間夠不夠。意圖題要看引號前後在講什麼，不要只翻字面。
practice.zh: 題目：說話者為什麼說「這樣對您的廚房人員會不會太趕」？ ／ 答案：確認員工是否還有足夠時間準備。
optsZh: 確認員工是否還有足夠時間準備
建議員工比平常晚下班

practice.q: What does the speaker offer?
opts: To lend the listener a vehicle
To add extra items at no cost
To provide staff for the banquet
practice.exp: we won't be charging you a delivery fee this month → waive a charge。waive（免除）是同義改寫的常客：waive a fee = not charge = free of charge。借車是說話者向別人借，不是借給聽者。
practice.zh: 題目：說話者提供什麼補償？ ／ 答案：免除一筆費用。

practice.q: What is the purpose of Ana's visit?
practice.exp: show you the new booking system before it goes live → demonstrate a new system。go live（正式上線）是常考片語。第一位說話者叫了兩個名字，代表她不是那兩人，聽到 Thanks…Dr. Brooks, Priya 就知道她是安娜。
practice.zh: 題目：安娜來訪的目的是什麼？ ／ 答案：示範一套新系統。

practice.q: Why does Dr. Brooks say, "I've heard that before"?
opts: He doubts that a promise will be kept.
He wants Ana to repeat her explanation.
He has already used the new system.
He agrees that the system is easy to learn.
practice.exp: 安娜說 nothing will get lost this time，醫師回 I've heard that before → 以前也有人這樣保證，結果沒做到，表示懷疑。安娜接著 Fair enough（可以理解）也證明他是在質疑。
practice.zh: 題目：布魯克斯醫師為什麼說「這句話我聽過了」？ ／ 答案：他懷疑這個承諾會兌現。
optsZh: 他懷疑這個承諾會兌現。
他想要安娜再說明一次。
他已經用過這套新系統。
他同意這套系統很好學。

practice.q: What does Priya agree to do?
opts: Practice using the system on Sunday
Work an extra shift on Saturday
Call patients to remind them of appointments
Set up an account for Dr. Brooks
practice.exp: I'm away on Saturday, but I could come in on Sunday → 星期天來試用。Saturday 是故意的干擾；開練習帳號的是安娜，不是普莉雅。
practice.zh: 題目：普莉雅同意做什麼？ ／ 答案：星期天來練習使用系統。
optsZh: 星期天來練習使用系統
幫布魯克斯醫師開帳號

test.q: Why does the woman object to a suggestion?
opts: The room is located near a noisy area.
The room is too small for the group.
The room has already been reserved.
test.exp: Birch is right next to the break room, and it gets really noisy → located near a noisy area。湯姆提議樺木廳，蕾娜反對。
test.zh: 題目：女子為什麼反對一項提議？ ／ 答案：那間會議室在吵雜的區域旁邊。
optsZh: 那間會議室在吵雜的區域旁邊。
那間會議室對這群人來說太小。
那間會議室已經被訂走。
那間會議室的設備太舊。

test.q: Look at the graphic. Which room will the speakers most likely use?
test.exp: 九人＋視訊：楓木太小、雪松沒視訊、樺木太吵 → book the largest one = 20 人的 Oak。答案在圖表上，但對話裡從沒說 Oak 這個字，要用「最大的」去對照。
test.zh: 題目：看圖表。說話者最可能用哪間會議室？ ／ 答案：橡木廳。

test.q: What does Tom say he will do this afternoon?
opts: Send a link to colleagues overseas
test.exp: 湯姆是第二位男聲（丹尼爾開頭叫了 Lena, Tom）。I'll send the Seoul team the meeting link → colleagues overseas。
test.zh: 題目：湯姆說他今天下午會做什麼？ ／ 答案：把連結寄給海外的同事。
optsZh: 把連結寄給海外的同事

test.q: Why does the woman want to accept the order?
opts: The client is a long-standing customer.
The client has offered to pay in advance.
The bakery has had few orders recently.
The event will promote the bakery's products.
test.exp: they've ordered from us every month for two years → long-standing customer（老客戶）。regular / loyal / long-standing customer 都是同一個意思。
test.zh: 題目：女子為什麼想接這筆訂單？ ／ 答案：對方是長期往來的客戶。
optsZh: 對方是長期往來的客戶。
這場活動會幫麵包店宣傳產品。

test.q: What does Julia suggest?
opts: Reducing the size of the order
Asking the client for more time
test.exp: push the seasonal menu tasting back to next week → rescheduling a tasting。push back = postpone = reschedule。茱莉亞是第二位女聲；提早來幫忙的是肯。
test.zh: 題目：茱莉亞建議什麼？ ／ 答案：把一場試吃活動改期。

test.q: Why does Ken say, "That's a first"?
opts: He is surprised by an unusual request.
He is proud of a recent achievement.
He wants to be the first to make the delivery.
He is confirming that it is the first order of the month.
test.exp: 前一句：他們以前都自己來拿，這次卻要求送貨 → That's a first（這還是第一次）表示這個要求不尋常。接著 though 帶出貨車沒空的問題。
test.zh: 題目：肯為什麼說「這倒是頭一遭」？ ／ 答案：他對一個不尋常的要求感到意外。
optsZh: 他對一個不尋常的要求感到意外。
他對最近的成就感到驕傲。
他在確認這是本月第一筆訂單。

test.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
opts: The results of a customer survey
A plan to expand a menu
The hiring of a data analyst
test.exp: 第一句就是主題：the results of the customer survey。delivery、menu、analytics 都在對話或圖表裡出現過，是故意的干擾。
test.zh: 題目：說話者主要在討論什麼？ ／ 答案：一份顧客問卷的結果。

test.q: Look at the graphic. Which issue does the woman want to address?
test.exp: 價格（41%）是總公司決定的，女子說 focus on the next biggest issue → 第二高的 Late deliveries（26%）。題目問「排第幾」時，圖表要看順序，不是看最大值。
test.zh: 題目：看圖表。女子想處理哪個問題？ ／ 答案：送貨延遲。

test.q: What does the man say he will do?
opts: Ask a colleague to provide some data
test.exp: I'll ask Hiro in analytics to send it to you → ask a colleague to provide data。it 指上一句的 cancellation data。
test.zh: 題目：男子說他會做什麼？ ／ 答案：請一位同事提供資料。
optsZh: 就價格問題聯絡總公司

test.q: What problem does Sam mention?
opts: A product is no longer being made.
Some electrical work failed an inspection.
A shipment went to the wrong address.
The walls need to be repainted.
test.exp: the manufacturer has stopped producing the oak pattern → no longer being made（停產）。discontinued 也是同一個意思。電路工程是戴夫說的，而且已經完成。
test.zh: 題目：山姆提到什麼問題？ ／ 答案：某個產品已經停產。
optsZh: 部分電路工程沒通過檢查。

test.q: Why does Ms. Ortiz choose one of the samples?
test.exp: This one's in stock → let's go with the one in stock，因為員工下個月初要搬回來 → available right away。她說兩款都比原本淺，所以 C 錯。
test.zh: 題目：歐提茲女士為什麼選其中一款樣品？ ／ 答案：可以馬上拿到。

test.q: What does Dev say he will do tonight?
test.exp: I'll update the schedule and e-mail it to you tonight → send an updated timeline。schedule ↔ timeline 是常見改寫。
test.zh: 題目：戴夫說他今晚會做什麼？ ／ 答案：寄出更新後的時程表。

test.q: Look at the graphic. Which session will now begin at two o'clock?
test.exp: 哈達德原本兩點，兩點半才到，所以和三點的佩特洛娃互換 → 兩點改成 Data Privacy Basics。圖表題遇到「互換、延後、取消」，要在圖上自己把格子對調。
test.zh: 題目：看圖表。現在哪一場會在兩點開始？ ／ 答案：資料隱私入門。

test.q: Why does the speaker say, "Fifty people, forty chairs"?
opts: To suggest that listeners arrive early for a session
To ask for help setting up more chairs
To announce that registration has closed
To correct an error in the program
test.exp: 很多人報名四點的座談，人比椅子多 → 暗示想要座位就早點來。意圖題常是這種「只講事實、不講結論」的短句，要自己補出言外之意。
test.zh: 題目：說話者為什麼說「50 個人，40 張椅子」？ ／ 答案：暗示聽眾某個場次要早點到。
optsZh: 暗示聽眾某個場次要早點到

test.q: According to the speaker, how can listeners win a prize?
opts: By submitting feedback through an app
By registering for next year's event
By asking a question at the panel
test.exp: fill out the feedback form in the conference app → entered in a drawing。next year's event 是獎品內容，不是參加方式。
test.zh: 題目：根據說話者，聽眾要怎麼得獎？ ／ 答案：透過 App 提交回饋。
optsZh: 透過 App 提交回饋
